test_title: SSC MTS 2024 Official Paper (Held On: 22 Oct, 2024 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: Which of the following government initiatives focuses on skill development to reduce open unemployment among youth in India?

options.text: Mahatma Gandhi National Rural Employment Guarantee Act (MGNREGA)

solution:
The correct answer is __**Pradhan Mantri Kaushal Vikas Yojana (PMKVY)**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

 
• The **Pradhan Mantri Kaushal Vikas Yojana (PMKVY)** is a flagship scheme under the Ministry of Skill Development and Entrepreneurship (MSDE) aimed at **providing skill training to youth** to enhance employability and reduce unemployment.
 
• Launched in **2015**, the scheme focuses on **short-term training (STT)**
